# ============================================================
# Logging Configuration
# ============================================================

@dataclass
class LogConfig:
    level: str = 'INFO'
    format: str = '%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s'
    file_path: Optional[str] = 'logs/app.log'
    max_bytes: int = 10485760
    backup_count: int = 5
    enable_json: bool = False

# ============================================================
# Application Init Config
# ============================================================

@dataclass
class AppConfig:
    server: ServerConfig = field(default_factory=ServerConfig)
    database: DatabaseConfig = field(default_factory=DatabaseConfig)
    cache: CacheConfig = field(default_factory=CacheConfig)
    queue: QueueConfig = field(default_factory=QueueConfig)

MIN_TTL = 0
MAX_TTL = 86400
MIN_CACHE_CONNECTIONS = 1
MAX_CACHE_CONNECTIONS = 200

# ============================================================
# External Declarations
# ============================================================

def validate_config(config: Any) -> List[str]:
    errors = []
    for f in fields(config):
        val = getattr(config, f.name)
        if val is None and f.metadata.get('required', False):
            errors.append(f'Missing required field: {f.name}')
    return errors

def validate_database_url(url: str) -> bool:
    pattern = r'^(postgresql|mysql|sqlite|mongodb)://'
    return bool(re.match(pattern, url))
